pages.title: Flamebearer's Arsenal
pages.text: $(bold)Everything else Hazen N Stuff makes: its blades, staves and spell weapons, its armour sets, rings and charms. The Flamebearer's officers guard the way.$(br2)$(thing)Relics$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(thing)64 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Runes and Orbs.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill an officer of the Flamebearer$(n)$(br2)Pays 8 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
